title: Yakitori-Style Pork Skewers
description: Inspired by the flavors of Japanese street food, these pork skewers are marinated in a sweet and savory sauce, then grilled to perfection. Perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, rice vinegar, ginger, brown sugar, and sesame oil to make the marinade.
2. Add the pork cubes to the marinade and mix well to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
4. Thread the marinated pork cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
5. Brush the grill with sesame oil to prevent sticking.
6. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the pork is cooked through and slightly charred.
7. Transfer the skewers to a serving platter and sprinkle with chopped green onions and toasted sesame seeds.
